Container.Name: photostead
Container.Overview: Photostead: a self-hosted photo and video library. One container: the server, the web app and its database. Existing folders are mounted read-only and indexed in place.

Config.Name: Photo library
Config.Description: The photostead share (Primary: cache, Secondary: array, Mover: cache to array). Originals live here.

Config.Name: Photo library, array only
Config.Description: The same share seen without the cache, for large migrations that would overflow the cache pool

Config.Name: PHOTOSTEAD_MANAGED_ROOT
Config.Description: Where the app reads the photo library

Config.Name: Library: images (read-only)
Config.Description: Existing folder indexed in place during migration

Config.Name: Library: videos (read-only)
Config.Description: Existing folder indexed in place during migration

Config.Name: PHOTOSTEAD_PUBLIC_URL
Config.Description: The address people reach Photostead at, e.g. https://photos.example.com (for single sign-on's return address). Empty: whatever address each visit uses

Config.Name: PHOTOSTEAD_OIDC_ISSUER
Config.Description: Single sign-on: the OpenID Connect provider's issuer URL (Authentik, Authelia, Keycloak, Pocket ID…). Empty: off

Config.Name: PHOTOSTEAD_OIDC_CLIENT_ID
Config.Description: Single sign-on: the client id the provider gave Photostead

Config.Name: PHOTOSTEAD_OIDC_NAME
Config.Description: Single sign-on: the name on the sign-in button (Sign in with …)

Config.Name: PHOTOSTEAD_OIDC_NEW_ACCOUNTS
Config.Description: Single sign-on: on makes an account for someone the provider knows but Photostead doesn't (otherwise only existing accounts, matched by verified email)

Config.Name: PHOTOSTEAD_MAP
Config.Description: off hides the map (its tiles come from OpenFreeMap, which sees the areas you look at; places are named offline either way)

Config.Name: PHOTOSTEAD_UPLOAD_PIECE
Config.Description: Behind a reverse proxy that caps a request's size: the most a phone sends in one request, in MiB. Empty: a file goes whole (in 64 MiB pieces through Cloudflare, by itself)

Config.Name: PHOTOSTEAD_TRUSTED_PROXIES
Config.Description: The reverse proxies whose X-Forwarded-For is believed, so wrong pairing codes and passwords count per person: addresses or ranges, private for the default, off for none. Empty: a proxy on this server, its Docker networks or the home network (loopback and private addresses)
